purpose: Opt-in image grounding and text-capacity checks; not a vision-quality or throughput benchmark

runtime.deployment: Public Dockerfile and launcher; cached base/runtime layers from docker-validation.json; no native runtime mounts
runtime.vision_dtype: bfloat16; unchanged checkpoint tensors; AutoRound metadata excludes visual weights from INT4
runtime.swap: 8 GiB original plus 56 GiB temporary; temporary file removed after server shutdown

image_checks.protocol: OpenAI chat image_url data URLs; temperature 0; thinking disabled; max_tokens 512; sequential requests
image_checks.prompt: Read the code printed at the top and identify the colors of the left circle and right square. Return only a JSON object with string keys code, left_color, right_color. Use lowercase color names. Do not add markdown.
image_checks.fixtures: White PNG canvas; black printed code; colored left circle and right square. Expected codes/colors were not included in the text prompt.

two_image_limit_check.message: At most 1 image(s) may be provided in one prompt. (parameter=image)

image_checks.timing_note: Whole non-streaming request time, including preprocessing and generation; first-use JIT occurred. Not isolated encoder or decode timings.

text_checks_with_encoder_loaded.request_recipe: repo-chat; unique cache salt; forced-length output
text_checks_with_encoder_loaded.warmup_policy: The three image checks ran first; no explicit text warmup or repeated measurements

cleanup: Server stopped normally; temporary swap removed; original swap retained
not_tested: Broad vision quality or realistic screenshot benchmark suites
Multiple images per request, concurrent vision requests, or video
Matched throughput comparison against text-only serving
